title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Payment Table — Retention Reserve Held from a Carried Benefit
content:
For the first carried payment on an Orthodontic Benefit Riders case, a retention reserve is held back from the carried benefit. The reserve is paid with the final payment of the case once appliance removal is reported.

| Appliance on the case | Retention reserve held back |
|---|---|
| fixed braces | 10 percent |
| clear aligners | 5 percent |
| limited or interceptive, or any other case | none |

The appliance type is read from the case's establishment entry.

*Hypothetical figures:* from an amount of 1,364.00, a fixed-braces case holds back 136.40 (10 percent) and an aligner case holds back 68.20 (5 percent). A limited case holds back nothing.
